mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_evaluation(user_id, session_id, course_id, question, ai_answer, thumbs, rating, comment, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{courseId}, #{question}, #{aiAnswer}, #{thumbs}, #{rating}, #{comment}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update:
UPDATE chat_evaluation
thumbs = #{thumbs},
rating = #{rating},
comment = #{comment},
update_time = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, session_id AS sessionId, course_id AS courseId, question, ai_answer AS aiAnswer, thumbs, rating, comment, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM chat_evaluation WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, session_id AS sessionId, course_id AS courseId, question, ai_answer AS aiAnswer, thumbs, rating, comment, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM chat_evaluation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND question = #{question} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, session_id AS sessionId, course_id AS courseId, question, ai_answer AS aiAnswer, thumbs, rating, comment, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM chat_evaluation WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
